package repro

const documentation = "parentheses should not change assignment ownership"

type State struct {
    Count int
}

func unusedHelper() int {
    value := 4
    return value + 1
}

func Mutate(shared *State) {
    scratch := []int{1, 2, 3}
    _ = scratch
    local := new(State)
    ((local)) = shared
    local.Count++
}

func unusedTail() bool {
    return true
}
